
```{r load-subsets}
subset_dir <- here("CSVresults", "subexperiment_keycols")
sub1_path <- file.path(subset_dir, "sub1_key_cols.csv")
sub2_path <- file.path(subset_dir, "sub2_key_cols.csv")
sub3_path <- file.path(subset_dir, "sub3_key_cols.csv")

sub1 <- read.csv(sub1_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sub2 <- read.csv(sub2_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sub3 <- read.csv(sub3_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Loaded", nrow(sub1), "rows for sub1,", nrow(sub2), "for sub2,", nrow(sub3), "for sub3.\n")
```

```{r prepare-plot-data}
parse_resp_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]", "", as.character(x))))
}

flag_to_bool <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x != 0)
  str <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  str %in% c("1", "true", "yes", "y")
}

prepare_subset_for_plots <- function(data) {
  mutated <- data %>%
    mutate(
      rt_ms = parse_resp_num(response_RT_from_start),
      precision_deg = parse_resp_num(response_error_deg),
      abs_precision_deg = abs(precision_deg),
      too_fast_flag = flag_to_bool(too_fast_trigger),
      too_slow_flag = flag_to_bool(too_slow_trigger)
    )

  filtered <- mutated %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(participant_id),
      !too_fast_flag,
      !too_slow_flag,
      !is.na(rt_ms),
      rt_ms >= 300,
      rt_ms <= 3000
    )

  stats <- list(
    total = nrow(mutated),
    missing_pid = sum(is.na(mutated$participant_id)),
    too_fast = sum(mutated$too_fast_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    too_slow = sum(mutated$too_slow_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_rt = sum(is.na(mutated$rt_ms)),
    rt_below = sum(mutated$rt_ms < 300, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt_above = sum(mutated$rt_ms > 3000, na.rm = TRUE),
    retained = nrow(filtered)
  )

  list(data = filtered, stats = stats)
}

print_filter_stats <- function(label, stats) {
  cat(sprintf("%s: retained %d/%d trials after RT bounds and flag filtering.\n", label, stats$retained, stats$total))
  cat(sprintf("  - missing participant_id: %d\n", stats$missing_pid))
  cat(sprintf("  - too fast flag: %d\n", stats$too_fast))
  cat(sprintf("  - too slow flag: %d\n", stats$too_slow))
  cat(sprintf("  - missing RT: %d\n", stats$missing_rt))
  cat(sprintf("  - RT < 300ms: %d\n", stats$rt_below))
  cat(sprintf("  - RT > 3000ms: %d\n", stats$rt_above))
}

sub1_prep <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub1)
sub2_prep <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub2)
sub3_prep <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub3)

sub1 <- sub1_prep$data
sub2 <- sub2_prep$data
sub3 <- sub3_prep$data

print_filter_stats("Sub1", sub1_prep$stats)
print_filter_stats("Sub2", sub2_prep$stats)
print_filter_stats("Sub3", sub3_prep$stats)
```

```{r filter-preview}
# Example filtering steps for downstream analyses; edit and add new filters as needed.
sub1_total <- nrow(sub1)
sub1_no_cue <- sum(is.na(sub1$cue_type) | trimws(sub1$cue_type) == "")
sub1_filtered <- sub1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(cue_type) & trimws(cue_type) != "")

sub2_total <- nrow(sub2)
allowed_sets <- c(2, 4, 6)
sub2_invalid_set <- sum(is.na(sub2$num_items) | !(sub2$num_items %in% allowed_sets))
sub2_filtered <- sub2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(num_items), num_items %in% allowed_sets)

sub3_total <- nrow(sub3)
sub3_missing_rt <- sum(is.na(sub3$response_RT_from_start))
sub3_filtered <- sub3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(response_RT_from_start))

cat(sprintf("sub1: removed %d/%d rows with empty cue_type (retained %d).\n",
            sub1_no_cue, sub1_total, nrow(sub1_filtered)))
cat(sprintf("sub2: removed %d/%d rows outside set sizes %s (retained %d).\n",
            sub2_invalid_set, sub2_total, paste(allowed_sets, collapse = ", "), nrow(sub2_filtered)))
cat(sprintf("sub3: removed %d/%d rows with missing RT (retained %d).\n",
            sub3_missing_rt, sub3_total, nrow(sub3_filtered)))
```

```{r map-participants}
reindex_participants <- function(data) {
  unique_ids <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    original_id = unique_ids,
    participant_id_new = sprintf("%02d", seq_along(unique_ids))
  )

  result_data <- data %>%
    left_join(lookup, by = c("participant_id" = "original_id")) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = coalesce(participant_id_new, participant_id)) %>%
    select(-participant_id_new)

  list(data = result_data, lookup = lookup %>% rename(participant_id = participant_id_new))
}

sub1_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub1)
sub2_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub2)
sub3_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub3)

sub1 <- sub1_reindexed$data
sub2 <- sub2_reindexed$data
sub3 <- sub3_reindexed$data

participant_id_record <- bind_rows(
  mutate(sub1_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub1"),
  mutate(sub2_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub2"),
  mutate(sub3_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub3")
)

cat("Participant ID mapping (original -> new):\n")
print(participant_id_record)
```

```{r plotting-utils, include=FALSE}
build_precision_plot <- function(data, sub_label, pid) {
  participant_data <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(participant_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  circ_sd <- tryCatch({
    circular::sd.circular(
      circular::circular(participant_data$precision_deg %% 360, units = "degrees"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

  ggplot(participant_data, aes(x = abs_precision_deg)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue3", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = paste(sub_label, "-", pid),
      subtitle = sprintf("circSD = %.2f°", ifelse(is.na(circ_sd), NA_real_, circ_sd)),
      x = "Absolute precision (deg)",
       y = "Trial count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

build_rt_plot <- function(data, sub_label, pid) {
  participant_data <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(participant_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  mean_rt <- mean(participant_data$rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(participant_data, aes(x = rt_ms)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "tomato2", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_rt, linetype = "dashed", color = "navy") +
    labs(
      title = paste(sub_label, "-", pid),
      subtitle = sprintf("RT distribution (mean %.0f ms)", ifelse(is.na(mean_rt), NA_real_, mean_rt)),
      x = "Response time (ms)",
      y = "Trial count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

render_participant_logits <- function(plot_fn, data, sub_label) {
  participants <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  purrr::walk(participants, function(pid) {
    plot_obj <- plot_fn(data, sub_label, pid)
    if (!is.null(plot_obj)) print(plot_obj)
  })
}
```

